export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"fail","link":"https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/actions/runs/43/job"}]'
run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'run rerun' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "head change did not reset rerun budget"

# Direct green merges are pinned to the structured head and close only on MERGED.
reset green "$policy"
export FAKE_HEAD=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'
run_patrol
grep -q -- "--match-head-commit $FAKE_HEAD" "$FAKE_GH_LOG" || fail "merge did not pin head SHA"
grep -q '^close ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "merged PR did not close bead"

# gh may queue a merge while returning success; leave the bead under patrol.
reset queued-merge "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_POST_MERGE_STATE=OPEN
run_patrol
[[ "$(count '^close ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "open queued merge closed bead"
grep -q 'merge-queued:' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "queued merge was not transitioned"

# Bad PR data, unavailable checks, and unknown buckets all fail closed.
reset malformed-pr "$policy"
export FAKE_PR_BODY='not json'
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'
run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "malformed PR data merged"
reset unavailable-checks "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='not json' FAKE_CHECKS_EXIT=1
run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "unavailable checks merged"
reset malformed-checks "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='not json'
run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "malformed checks merged"
reset unknown-bucket "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"mystery","link":""}]'
run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "unknown check bucket merged"

# Preflight blocks remain queued (the exit code cannot identify a red base).
reset preflight "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1
run_patrol; run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "preflight block merged"
[[ "$(count --append-notes "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "preflight annotations were not idempotent"

# Waiting transitions are also idempotent across timer invocations, including
# when the pending/failing counts change under the same head.
reset idempotent "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pending","link":""}]'
run_patrol; run_patrol
[[ "$(count --append-notes "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "waiting annotations were not idempotent"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pending","link":""},{"name":"two","bucket":"pending","link":""}]'
run_patrol
[[ "$(count --append-notes "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "waiting note grew with changing check counts"

# Note-only handoffs from before pr_babysit_* metadata remain supported.
reset legacy '{}' '[pr-handoff 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z] repo=gastownhall/beads pr=123 method=rebase flake_rerun=allowed — patrol owns the merge'
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'
run_patrol
grep -q -- '--rebase' "$FAKE_GH_LOG" || fail "legacy note-only method was not honored"

# A legacy gh-pr-N external reference resolves to the default repository.
reset legacy-ref "$policy" '' 'gh-pr-123'
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'
run_patrol
grep -q -- 'pr merge 123 --repo gastownhall/beads' "$FAKE_GH_LOG" || fail "legacy gh-pr-N reference did not resolve"

# A PR already MERGED at first read closes the bead without a merge attempt;
# one CLOSED unmerged leaves the queue for a decision.

export FAKE_PR_STATE=MERGED
run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "already-merged PR attempted a merge"
grep -q '^close ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "already-merged PR did not close bead"
reset closed-unmerged "$policy"
export FAKE_PR_STATE=CLOSED
run_patrol
grep -q 'closed-unmerged' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "closed-unmerged PR was not transitioned"
grep -q -- '--remove-label merge-when-green' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "closed-unmerged PR kept the queue label"

# Handoff validates arguments and writes namespaced policy metadata.  A
# non-default repository must never query the legacy gh-pr-N reference.

else
  status=$?

fi
reset handoff '{}'
"$ROOT/scripts/pr-handoff" 123 --repo owner/other --method rebase >/dev/null
grep -q 'pr_babysit_repo=owner/other' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "handoff did not write policy metadata"
! grep -q 'gh-pr-123' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "handoff used legacy reference for another repository"

# timeout in the generated user service.

stable_root="$(cd "$(dirname "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --git-common-dir)")" && pwd)"
XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$install_config" "$ROOT/scripts/install-pr-babysit" >/dev/null
grep -Fq "ExecStart=\"$stable_root/scripts/pr-babysit\"" "$install_config/systemd/user/pr-babysit.service" || fail "installer did not write stable root"
grep -q '^TimeoutStartSec=10min$' "$install_config/systemd/user/pr-babysit.service" || fail "installed service lacks timeout"
grep -Eq '^verify .+\.service$' "$FAKE_SYSTEMD_ANALYZE_LOG" || fail "installer did not validate a .service-shaped temporary file"

run_patrol; [[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "nonzero initial gh view merged"
reset postmerge-status "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_POST_PR_EXIT=1
run_patrol; [[ "$(count '^close ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "nonzero post-merge view closed bead"

# Re-read after preflight, before CAS merge; an altered head cannot be merged.
reset changed-head "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_HEAD_AFTER_PREFLIGHT=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
run_patrol; [[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "changed head reached merge"

reset empty-checks "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[]'; run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "empty checks merged"
reset bad-policy '{"pr_babysit_method":"bogus","pr_babysit_flake_rerun":"allowed"}'; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'; run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "invalid metadata policy merged"
reset stale-policy '{}' 'method=merge flake_rerun=allowed'; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'; run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "non-marker stale policy merged"

# Reservation failure calls no rerun; handoff retains a spent budget; legacy

reset reservation "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"fail","link":"https://github.com/x/y/actions/runs/42/job"}]' FAKE_BD_FAIL_MATCH='pr_babysit_rerun_head='
run_patrol; [[ "$(count 'run rerun' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "rerun ran without reservation"
reset repeat-handoff '{"pr_babysit_method":"squash","pr_babysit_flake_rerun":"allowed","pr_babysit_rerun_head":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}'
"$ROOT/scripts/pr-handoff" 123 >/dev/null
[[ "$(grep -c 'pr_babysit_rerun_head=' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "handoff cleared rerun budget"
reset legacy-spent '{}' $'[pr-handoff 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z] repo=gastownhall/beads pr=123 method=squash flake_rerun=allowed — patrol owns the merge\n[pr-babysit 2026-01-01T00:01:00Z] flake-rerun-done'
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"fail","link":"https://github.com/x/y/actions/runs/42/job"}]'; run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'run rerun' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "legacy spent rerun retried"

# Red-base-only failures retain the bead; a policy block becomes actionable.
reset red-base "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1 FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT='[block] Base branch main CI is RED: Main failed at 2026-07-24T00:00:00Z'
run_patrol; [[ "$(grep -c -- '--status open' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || true)" == 0 ]] || fail "red base blocked bead"

# A red base raises exactly one bead per base — after a bounded wait, never

red_state="$CASE/state/pr-babysit/red-base"
export PR_BABYSIT_RED_BASE_LIMIT=3
run_patrol   # pass 2 of 3
[[ "$(count '^create ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "red base escalated before its budget"
grep -q $'^gastownhall/beads@main\t2\t' "$red_state" || fail "red base counter did not advance"
run_patrol  # reaches the limit
[[ "$(count '^create ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "red base did not raise exactly one bead"
grep -q 'create Base branch gastownhall/beads@main has been red' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "escalation bead does not name the base"

run_patrol
[[ "$(count '^create ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "red base raised a duplicate bead"

for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do run_patrol; done
[[ "$(count 'still red after' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "standing red-base bead took an unbounded note stream"

saved_queue="$(cat "$FAKE_QUEUE")"; printf '[]\n' >"$FAKE_QUEUE"
run_patrol
[[ -f "$red_state" ]] || fail "empty queue cleared red-base state"
printf '%s\n' "$saved_queue" >"$FAKE_QUEUE"

# Recovery is keyed: a green sighting of a DIFFERENT base is not recovery of

printf 'gastownhall/beads@release-1.2\t9\t2026-07-28T00:00:00Z\tmybd-other\n' >>"$red_state"
unset FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT
run_patrol
grep -q '^close mybd-other' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" && fail "green base withdrew a different base's escalation"
grep -q $'^gastownhall/beads@release-1.2\t9\t' "$red_state" || fail "untouched base's record was not carried forward"

grep -q '^close mybd-created' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "recovered base did not withdraw its escalation"

# A truncated or hand-edited record is dropped, not trusted: read back through

reset red-base-corrupt "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1 \

mkdir -p "$CASE/state/pr-babysit"; printf 'gastownhall/beads@main\n' >"$CASE/state/pr-babysit/red-base"
run_patrol; run_patrol; run_patrol
[[ "$(count '^create ' "$FAKE_BD_LOG")" == 1 ]] || fail "corrupt state record suppressed escalation"
grep -q 'dropping unparseable state record' "$CASE/state/pr-babysit/patrol.log" || fail "corrupt state record was silently discarded"
unset PR_BABYSIT_RED_BASE_LIMIT

reset policy-block "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1 FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT='[block] Merge conflict detected'
run_patrol; grep -q -- '--status open' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "policy block did not open/block bead"
reset partial-block "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"fail","link":""}]' FAKE_BD_FAIL_ON=update
run_patrol; ! grep -q 'BLOCKED' "$XDG_STATE_HOME/pr-babysit/patrol.log" || fail "failed atomic update logged blocked"
reset reference-mismatch '{"pr_babysit_method":"squash","pr_babysit_flake_rerun":"allowed","pr_babysit_repo":"other/repo","pr_babysit_pr":"123"}'
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'; run_patrol
grep -q -- '--status open' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "reference/metadata mismatch was not blocked"

# Overrides are inspected/canonicalized; automatic duplicate candidates fail.
reset override-mismatch '{}' '' 'gh:other/repo#99'
if "$ROOT/scripts/pr-handoff" 123 --bead mybd-test >/dev/null 2>&1; then fail "mismatched override accepted"; fi
reset override-empty '{}' '' ''
"$ROOT/scripts/pr-handoff" 123 --bead mybd-test >/dev/null
grep -q -- '--external-ref gh:gastownhall/beads#123' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "empty override was not canonicalized"
reset duplicates '{}'
jq '. + [{id:"mybd-other", external_ref:"gh-pr-123", notes:"", metadata:{}}]' "$FAKE_QUEUE" >"$FAKE_QUEUE.tmp" && mv -f "$FAKE_QUEUE.tmp" "$FAKE_QUEUE"
if "$ROOT/scripts/pr-handoff" 123 >/dev/null 2>&1; then fail "duplicate automatic matches accepted"; fi

# Exit-zero preflight still needs an explicit base-green pass line.
reset base-unknown "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT='[warn] Base branch health is unknown'
run_patrol; [[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "unknown base health merged"

# The final rollup is part of the same head snapshot and must be conclusively green.
for case_name in rollup-pending rollup-failed rollup-malformed; do
  reset "$case_name" "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'
  case "$case_name" in
    rollup-pending) export FAKE_ROLLUP='[{"__typename":"CheckRun","status":"IN_PROGRESS","conclusion":null}]' ;;
    rollup-failed) export FAKE_ROLLUP='[{"__typename":"StatusContext","state":"FAILURE"}]' ;;
    *) export FAKE_ROLLUP='[{"status":"COMPLETED"}]' ;;
  esac

reset authorization-revoked "$policy"; export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_REVOKE_LABEL=1
run_patrol; [[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "revoked authorization merged"
grep -q 'authorization-mismatch' "$FAKE_BD_LOG" || fail "authorization skip was not surfaced on the bead"

# Legacy note-only identity must agree with the external reference.
reset legacy-identity '{}' '[pr-handoff 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z] repo=other/repo pr=999 method=squash flake_rerun=allowed — patrol owns the merge'
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]'; run_patrol
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "mismatched legacy identity merged"

# --- transient merge-state handling -----------------------------------------

# Transient-only preflight blocks are retried, not blocked, until the limit.
reset transient "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1 FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT='[block] Merge state is UNKNOWN.'
run_patrol; run_patrol
jq -e '.[0].labels | index("merge-when-green")' "$FAKE_QUEUE" >/dev/null || fail "transient block removed queue label early"
[[ "$(jq -r '.[0].metadata.pr_babysit_transient' "$FAKE_QUEUE")" == "$FAKE_HEAD:2" ]] || fail "transient counter did not track passes"
run_patrol
jq -e '.[0].labels | index("merge-blocked")' "$FAKE_QUEUE" >/dev/null || fail "persistent transient block did not escalate"
[[ "$(count 'pr merge' "$FAKE_GH_LOG")" == 0 ]] || fail "transient block merged"

# A transient block that settles is retried in-pass and merges immediately:
# a merge flips every other PR to UNKNOWN, so without this a green backlog
# drains at one PR per pass while burning the others' transient budgets.
reset settle "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1 FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT='[block] Merge state is UNKNOWN.' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_SETTLES=1
run_patrol
[[ -f "$FAKE_MERGE_MARK" ]] || fail "settled transient did not merge in the same pass"
[[ "$(jq -r '.[0].metadata.pr_babysit_transient // "absent"' "$FAKE_QUEUE")" == absent ]] || fail "settled transient consumed the transient budget"

# Red base plus transient retains without consuming the transient budget.
reset transient-red "$policy"
export FAKE_CHECKS='[{"name":"unit","bucket":"pass","link":""}]' FAKE_PREFLIGHT_EXIT=1
export FAKE_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT='[block] Base branch main CI is RED: Main failed at 2026-07-24T00:00:00Z

Environment=GIT_ASKPASS=/bin/true
Type=oneshot
Environment=PATH=%h/.local/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
# Suite commands may carry their own long timeouts (e.g. go test -timeout 90m);
# give verify-next headroom past those instead of killing mid-suite.
Environment=VERIFY_TIMEOUT=100m
# bd resolves its database from the cwd; without this the run sees no queue.
WorkingDirectory=@ROOT@
# verify-next exits nonzero when a verification legitimately FAILS; the leading
# "-" keeps that routine outcome from aborting the activation before the bisect
# step runs. Running both in one oneshot serializes them for free (systemd will
# not start a new activation while this one is still running), so the two heavy
# git-worktree consumers never overlap.
ExecStart=-@ROOT@/scripts/verify-next
ExecStart=-@ROOT@/scripts/bisect-next
# Headroom for a verify pass (VERIFY_TIMEOUT) followed by a bisect (two oracle
# guard runs at BISECT_STEP_TIMEOUT plus git bisect at BISECT_TIMEOUT) in the
# same activation. base-red is rare, so this ceiling is almost never approached.
TimeoutStartSec=300min
# Full Beads/Dolt suites are process and disk heavy; stay polite on a
# workstation that may have interactive sessions running.
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=idle
[Unit]
Description=Run verify-next every 15 minutes

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:07/15
RandomizedDelaySec=45
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# verify-enqueue - record a beads source candidate for asynchronous validation.
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/verify-enqueue <bd-id-or-pr-num> <worktree> [verify command...]
#
# The worktree must be clean. Verification runs later from the recorded commit,
# not from uncommitted local state.

set -euo pipefail
. "$(dirname "$0")/_tri-lib.sh"
tri_require bd git jq

usage() {
  sed -n '2,8p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "-h" || "${1:-}" == "--help" ]]; then
  usage
  exit 0
fi

[[ $# -ge 2 ]] || {
  usage >&2
  exit 2
}

BD_ID="$(tri_resolve_bd_id "$1")"
shift

INPUT_WT="$1"
shift

VERIFY_CMD="${*:-make test}"

[[ -d "$INPUT_WT" ]] || tri_die "worktree does not exist: $INPUT_WT"
WT="$(cd "$INPUT_WT" && pwd -P)"

git -C "$WT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || tri_die "not a git worktree: $WT"

WT="$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
HEAD_SHA="$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)"
BRANCH="$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)"
[[ -n "$BRANCH" ]] || BRANCH="detached"

dirty="$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
if [[ -n "$dirty" ]]; then
  echo "verify-enqueue: refusing to enqueue a dirty worktree:" >&2
  git -C "$WT" status --short >&2
  echo >&2
  echo "Commit or clean the candidate first; verification runs from HEAD only." >&2
  exit 1
fi

git -C "$TRI_BD_MAIN" cat-file -e "$HEAD_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null \
  || tri_die "commit $HEAD_SHA is not visible from $TRI_BD_MAIN; use a worktree created from bd-main"

stamp="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
bd update "$BD_ID" \
  --set-metadata verify_state=queued \
  --set-metadata "verify_head=$HEAD_SHA" \
  --set-metadata "verify_branch=$BRANCH" \
  --set-metadata "verify_cmd=$VERIFY_CMD" \
  --set-metadata "verify_worktree=$WT" \
  --set-metadata "verify_enqueued_at=$stamp" \
  --set-metadata verify_started_at= \
  --set-metadata verify_finished_at= \
  --set-metadata verify_runner= \
  --set-metadata verify_result= \
  --set-metadata verify_log= \
  >/dev/null

tri_log_note "$BD_ID" "verification queued: head=${HEAD_SHA:0:12} branch=$BRANCH cmd='$VERIFY_CMD'"

echo "Queued verification for $BD_ID"
tri_kv "head" "$HEAD_SHA"
tri_kv "branch" "$BRANCH"
tri_kv "command" "$VERIFY_CMD"
tri_kv "source worktree" "$WT"

  surfaces it back to a human — no per-author attribution is attempted, so
  any activity after `pr_close_since` counts as engagement
- once the window elapses with no engagement, runs
  `gh pr close <n> --comment <pr_close_reason>` and closes the bd bead

A PR can only be in one lane at a time: `pr-close-handoff` refuses to hand
off a bead that already carries `merge-when-green`, and the patrol leaves a
bead alone (logged, untouched) if it somehow carries both labels.

**base-red** — not a lane you hand off to; a hand the patrol raises for
itself. Agents run `PR_PREFLIGHT_BLOCK_RED_BASE=1`, so a red base branch
blocks every `merge-when-green` lane behind it. That block is correct and the
lanes are deliberately left armed — no lane caused it, and blocking them would
burn N re-arms on one condition. But a red base was also the only persistent
condition with no counter and no escalation, so it could stall the whole queue
indefinitely in silence (2026-07-28: upstream main red ~8h, seven lanes
parked, 39 patrol passes to the log alone).

The patrol now tracks each red base in
`${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/pr-babysit/red-base` (one TAB-separated
`key<TAB>passes<TAB>first_seen<TAB>bead` record per `repo@branch`; unparseable
records are dropped and logged rather than trusted) and after
`PR_BABYSIT_RED_BASE_LIMIT` consecutive passes (default 5, ~1h) creates one
P0 bead labelled `base-red` naming the base, the failing run, and how many
lanes are parked. Follow-up notes are rate-limited to one per 10 passes; the
per-pass record lives in the patrol log.

Everything here is keyed per base: a green sighting of `main` never withdraws
an escalation for `release-1.2`, and only a *positively observed* green base
of the same identity closes the bead. An empty queue is absence of evidence,
not recovery. The corollary is worth knowing: if every parked lane is merged,
blocked or closed while the base is still red, no lane remains to observe
recovery and the bead stays open until a human closes it. The bead says so.

Nothing about this lane can block, unclaim, or otherwise mutate a merge tail —
it only ever creates, notes, or closes its own `base-red` bead.

**review-needed** — a detector, not an executor: it makes sure PR reviews
*get queued*, on first open and on follow-up activity; agent sessions consume
the queue via `bd ready`. The patrol sweeps open PRs in
`PR_BABYSIT_REVIEW_REPO` (default `gastownhall/beads`) each pass against
per-PR baselines in `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/pr-babysit/review-sweep.state`
(tri-drift pattern; the first pass seeds silently, so activation never floods
`bd ready` with the pre-existing backlog — that is a one-time manual sweep,
bead mybd-88rdq). Queue-worthy events:

- a PR opened since the last pass (unless authored by a self login)
- a draft flipped to ready for review (drafts are otherwise ignored, with
  their baseline kept current so the flip itself is the event)
- a moved head, unless every attributable new commit is authored solely by
  self logins (`PR_BABYSIT_SELF_LOGINS`, comma-separated, default `maphew`)

GREEN_BASE_KEYS=""      # one "key" line per base positively observed green
